sum: A pattern library for operating agents around a codebase: loops that discover work, hand it to an agent, verify the result and persist state, with an audit and a cost tool beside them.

evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 4 of the 5 neutral interface standards (MCP, AGENTS.md, Agent Plugins, Agent Skills)
evidence.se.residency: cites data_residency: local-first, the operator's state stays on their machine; keys are the operator's own (byok)
evidence.se.threats: cites th and ctrl: T4/T7/T8 introduced, controls limits part, log part, approval part, sandbox none
evidence.sf.reach: restates exec and ctrl: the entry does not execute on its own, and limits is part
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format markdown: Markdown, which any editor already reads
evidence.pe.budget: a ceiling the operator sets on the command line: tools/loop-context/src/cli.ts (--max-iterations)
evidence.co.coexist: states the hosts it sits beside: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Aider (README.md)
evidence.ic.error: a dry run the operator can ask for before the real one: tools/goal-init/src/cli.ts (dryRun)
evidence.se.attest: signs or attests what it publishes: .github/workflows/release-goal-audit.yml (npm publish --access public --provenance)
evidence.fx.install: an install that does not change the machine globally: README.md (npx @)
evidence.fx.byo: the provider is the operator's choice: BASEURL, OPENAI, ANTHROPIC (_config.yml)
evidence.sf.warn: the irreversible step is both warned about and gated: docs/QUICKSTART.md (**warning**)

pre: a repository with work a loop can discover, such as issues or failing checks
a verification step the loop can trust
anti: a single task somebody could just do
teams unwilling to run agents on a schedule
gnote: The only entry here that ships a cost tool and an audit for the loop itself, and one of the few that starts in report-only mode: the first week produces findings rather than commits. Loops that run in GitHub Actions inherit whatever that environment permits.

ja.sum: コードベースの周りでエージェントを運用するためのパターン集。仕事を見つけ、エージェントに渡し、結果を検証し、状態を残すループを設計する。監査ツールと費用ツールが付属する。
pre: issueや失敗した検査など、ループが発見できる仕事があるリポジトリ
ループが信頼できる検証手順
anti: 人がやれば済む単発の作業
エージェントを定期実行させる気のないチーム
ja.gnote: ループ自体の費用ツールと監査を配る唯一のツールで、最初の1週間を報告のみで始める数少ない例でもある。初週はコミットではなく所見を出す。GitHub Actionsで回すループは、その環境が許すものをそのまま引き継ぐ。
